decisions.reason: The saved page numbers identify where filler images should be placed; they do not change the requirement to derive table-of-contents entries from finalized article pagination.
The source concerns placement of filler images and does not change author names, author-photo identity, sources, or byline placement.
Image filename page assignments do not change article category labels, category mappings, or category-label placement.
The source specifies where supplied images belong and does not modify the approved Inter font family or its thicker readable treatment.
The page numbers saved with filler images are placement instructions for those images, not final article page references to be displayed on the cover.
The source concerns filler-image placement and does not alter author-photo shape or size.
The filler-image page assignments do not affect the restriction on using red in the Dorian Vale article.
Assigning filler images to intended pages does not change the pages-version upload format, even page-count rule, or two-page spread compatibility requirement.
The source assigns supplied filler images to pages and does not change which cover-mentioned articles must be included or who determines their placement.

The broad issue-assembly obligation remains unchanged; the image-to-page instruction is already owned by the narrower article-ending layout requirement and does not revise the Flat Plan reference or assembly behavior.
The source concerns filler images for article white-space correction and does not alter the tribute page or its placement toward the end of the magazine.
The image filename convention supplies page-placement metadata but does not modify the polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
